question: Who among the following Bharatnatyam dancers was bestowed with the title of Asthana Narthaki (Resident Dancer) by the Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanam temple?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Yamini Krishnamurthy.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** Yamini Krishnamurthy: was born in December 20, 1940, was known for her performances in **Bharatnatyam and Kuchipudi.
 
• She received **Padma Shri in 1968** and the Padma Bhushan in 2001</stro
